extracted_relations.evidence: Decimals are another representation of fractions.
Percentage can be written as a fraction.
Ratios compare quantities and can be expressed as fractions.
Standard form represents very large or small decimals.
Rounding to significant figures uses decimal place value.
Bounds arise from rounding to significant figures or decimal places.
Expressions use numbers such as integers.
Linear equations are equations formed from algebraic expressions.
Solving simultaneous equations uses linear equations.
Quadratic equations are algebraic equations of degree two.
Linear inequalities are solved using similar steps to linear equations.
Functions are often defined by algebraic expressions.
Gradient is calculated from coordinates on the Cartesian plane.
The line equation y = mx + c uses gradient m.
Parallel and perpendicular conditions use gradients.
Arc length and sector area are mensuration formulas.
Speed, distance and time use formula-based measurement.
Circle theorems use angle properties.
Enlargement is a transformation that produces similar shapes.
Trigonometric ratios use right-angled triangle angles.
Sine rule extends trigonometric ratios to non-right triangles.
Cosine rule extends trigonometric ratios to non-right triangles.
Area = ½ab sin C uses sine of an angle.
Tree diagrams represent probability outcomes.
Conditional probability is a type of probability.
Determinants are computed from matrices.
Finding a 2×2 inverse uses its determinant.
Vectors can be represented using coordinates.
Translation transformations use vector notation.
Median can be estimated from cumulative frequency.
